title: Further proof transformations, modal logic, and ordinal analysis
details: Extend pure extraction to Harrop antecedents, keeping explicit original-term or consistency hypotheses for existential witnesses. Develop equality-free first-order proof interpolation and general Herbrand extraction beyond leading existential blocks, with quantified contraction handled explicitly. Extend cut transformations to calculi preserving logical equality and establish any required equality-enabled conservativity. Study varying-domain Kripke completeness for constructive first-order logic. For propositional logic, develop terminating G4ip proof search and quantitative bounds on cut elimination. Strong normalization and confluence need an explicitly specified local natural-deduction reduction relation and proofs for its arbitrary reduction sequences. For constructive arithmetic, develop Friedman translations, appropriate arithmetic conservativity, realizability, numerical existence and disjunction properties, and provably total functions. Primitive recursive arithmetic and ordinal analysis require their own arithmetic-strength arguments; Goodstein termination by ordinal descent does not establish PA unprovability or a Gentzen consistency theorem. Heyting-algebra semantics needs its lattice foundations. Modal logic belongs in its own area.
